statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. The latest independently verified delayed NQ quote remains modestly positive in thin Labor Day trade, while persistent failed-retracement structure is not verified.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail remains below the block threshold; the 22:00 UTC futures reopen is the principal conditional escalation checkpoint.
headline: Nasdaq Tail remains WATCH as holiday liquidity meets extreme oil and geopolitical stress
body: The latest independently verified delayed NQ quote available was 29,613.75 (+0.16%) inside a 29,530.50–29,683.50 range on about 10% of its 65-day average volume. Reuters reported Brent at $97.47 by 12:14 UTC amid U.S.-Iran maritime escalation. Persistent NQ mean-reversion failure is unverified, keeping Tail at 20% while Stress remains 100%.
